ludo_findings.punch_prompt: Side-view punch animation, facing right. The character starts in a fighting stance, pulls the fist back, throws one straight punch forward, then returns to the starting stance. Feet stay planted in the same position. Fixed camera, full body always visible, consistent character design, proportions, colors and outfit. No opponent, no camera movement, no zoom, no added effects.
